design.scale_reduction_note: milestone brief suggests >=48 points and 8-10 seeds/point; this run used 16 points x 3 seeds, documented as a deliberate compute-budget reduction (see module docstring).

note: Region labels are purely descriptive, computed after every point was already run; no point was selected, retried, or excluded based on its outcome, and this search was not stopped early because a particular cluster count appeared.
